construction.description: Four independent seeded regressions in four pure modules: a character-length byte-budget check, a sample cap off by one, a release without its once guard, and a reservation prefix without its delimiter.
construction.nativeBoundary: Use the pinned source modules directly through their public exports, without mocks.

candidateBoundary: Only pinned source, sandbox.patch, and plan are candidate inputs. Acceptance and controls remain separate.
priorInspection: No candidate prompt or campaign result was inspected. This is development material, not an unseen-source claim.

controls.rationale: Restore the pinned implementation at all four sites.
Repair all four sites with independently written logic: a byte-length guard, a count-based sample cap, a permit set, and a first-segment comparison.

expectedFailures: acceptance/truncate-field.test.ts > truncate-field: keeps multi-byte text within the byte budget
controls.rationale: Repair three sites and leave truncateField comparing UTF-16 length with a byte budget.

expectedFailures: acceptance/repeat-coalescer.test.ts > repeat-coalescer: keeps at most 256 sampled repeats in arrival order
controls.rationale: Repair three sites and leave the repeat sample one past its cap.

expectedFailures: acceptance/session-fair-admission.test.ts > session-fair-admission: a repeated release frees its permit only once
acceptance/session-fair-admission.test.ts > session-fair-admission: a taken permit released twice creates no capacity
controls.rationale: Repair three sites and leave permit release without its once guard.

expectedFailures: acceptance/skill-id.test.ts > skill-id: accepts ids that only begin with the letters of the learned root
controls.rationale: Repair three sites and leave the learned reservation matching any id that begins with its letters.

expectedFailures: acceptance/session-fair-admission.test.ts > session-fair-admission: a repeated release frees its permit only once
acceptance/session-fair-admission.test.ts > session-fair-admission: a taken permit released twice creates no capacity
controls.rationale: Repair three sites and clamp the active count at zero, which still lets a repeated release admit extra work.

expectedFailures: acceptance/skill-id.test.ts > skill-id: still reserves the learned root and its namespace
controls.rationale: Repair three sites and narrow the learned reservation to the bare root, which releases the learned.* namespace.
